dung_chen_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Chen Qianyu
dung_chen_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Chen Qianyu is a master in lifting enemies into mid-air. She can quickly build-up Vulnerability stacks and also deal massive DMG and Stagger to a single target.</>

dung_pelica_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Perlica
dung_pelica_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Perlica is a caster who can effectively apply Electric Infliction and Electrification, opening up combat opportunities for other operators in the team.</>

dung_yvonne_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Yvonne
dung_yvonne_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Yvonne is a DMG dealer who leverages her critical hits. Try to apply Solidification with her skills to quickly gain Ultimate Energy. After casting her ultimate, Yvonne becomes a powerful single-target DMG dealer.</>

dung_endmin_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Endministrator
dung_endmin_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>The Endministrator is an all-rounded Physical guard, with a combo skill that caters to other operators and unique Originium Arts for sealing the enemy.</>

dung_laevat_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Laevatain
dung_laevat_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Laevatain is a striker with outstanding mass DMG skills. Her Final Strikes can absorb Heat Inflictions from nearby enemies to trigger powerful battle skills and combo skills. She can also use her ultimate to carve and burn her way through mobs of enemies.</>

dung_aglina_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Gilberta
dung_aglina_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Gilberta is a supporter with both Arts and Physical abilities. She can quickly Lift enemies after triggering Arts Reactions. Once cast, her ultimate also applies Arts Susceptibility to enemies within a large area.</>

dung_azrila_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Ember
dung_azrila_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Ember is a defender who attacks a target hitting the controlled operator while giving HP treatment to the latter. Her ultimate also grants a Shield to every teammate.</>

dung_ardelia_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Ardelia
dung_ardelia_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Ardelia is a supporter with outstanding HP treatment skills. Her battle skill and combo skill make enemies take more DMG, while her battle skill and ultimate can heal teammates.</>

dung_lastrite_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Last Rite
dung_lastrite_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Last Rite is a striker who deals DMG by stacking Cryo Inflictions. Her battle skill consumes little SP and help generate Final Strikes that apply Cryo Inflictions to enemies. Last Rite can also stack Cryo Inflictions to trigger combo skills and ultimates that deal massive Cryo DMG.</>

dung_pograni_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Pogranichnik
dung_pograni_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Pogranichnik is a vanguard with both Physical DMG dealing and SP recovery abilities. Try to consume multiple Vulnerability stacks to maximize the effects of his skills.</>

dung_lifeng_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Lifeng
dung_lifeng_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Lifeng is a good DMG dealer with a special focus on knocking down enemies. His combo skill gives a Link buff that increases the effectiveness of other operators.</>

dung_wolfgd_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Wulfgard
dung_wolfgd_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Wulfgard is skilled in applying Heat Infliction and Combustion. His battle skill also consumes the target's Combustion or Electrification to deal massive DMG.</>

dung_ikut_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Arclight
dung_ikut_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Arclight is an electric vanguard. She can consume Electrification of enemies to recover massive SP, making her a perfect teammate for operators who can apply Electric Infliction or Electrification.</>

dung_seraph_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Xaihi
dung_seraph_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Xaihi can use her battle skill to restore the HP of the controlled operator. Her ultimate can also grant Amp buffs to support the entire team.</>

dung_avywen_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Avywenna
dung_avywen_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Avywenna has a unique way to attack her enemies. She can throw Thunderlances into the battlefield and use her battle skill to retrieve all thrown lances at once, dealing massive Electric DMG at one go.</>

dung_aurora_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Snowshine
dung_aurora_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Snowshine can protect teammates by retaliating enemy attacks, provide HP treatment to injured teammates, and cast ultimates that can apply Solidification to the enemy.</>

dung_dapan_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Da Pan
dung_dapan_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Da Pan can easily apply various Physical Statuses on enemies. His combo skill also deals massive Physical DMG.</>

dung_deepfin_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Alesh
dung_deepfin_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Alesh is a vanguard with crowd control and SP recovery abilities. His battle skill can immediately apply Solidification to enemies with Cryo Infliction, while his combo skill recovers plenty of SP.</>

dung_tangtang_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Tangtang
dung_tangtang_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Tangtang is a caster who can apply Cryo Infliction and deal DMG to a crowd of enemies. Her combo skill is triggered by Cryo Inflictions or Arts Bursts, and is capable of enhancing Arts Susceptibility and DMG dealt by subsequent battle skills and ultimates. She synergizes very well with operators who benefit from Arts DMG.</>

dung_wulfa_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Rossi
dung_wulfa_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Rossi is a guard who can quickly apply stacks of Vulnerability and deal decent DMG. Her combo skill can convert the enemy's Arts Infliction into Physical Vulnerability. Rossi's ultimate also deals massive DMG.</>

dung_zhuangfy_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Zhuang Fangyi
dung_zhuangfy_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Zhuang Fangyi is a striker who can deal continuous and massive Electric DMG. Her battle skills can consume Electrification to create Sunderblades that unleash Thunder Strikes on the enemy. Her ultimate also greatly enhances her combat capabilities.</>

dung_mifu_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Mi Fu
dung_mifu_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Mi Fu is a Physical guard and a great DMG dealer. She can apply Physical Susceptibility and Crush to achieve a good DMG output. If her Crush consumes enough Vulnerability stacks, she can cast her battle skill again to deal an additional hit of massive DMG.</>

dung_camille_chartrain01.name: Operator Guide: Camille
dung_camille_chartrain01.desc: <@ct.key>Camille is a Heat element vanguard. He can summon Firefang Vesperwings to apply Heat Infliction, Weakness, and Heat Susceptibility on enemies, and use his combo skill and ultimate to restore lots of SP.</>
